notes: Every MIDI keyboard at once: ALL MIDI KEYBOARDS is the new default input, so whatever you play into this Mac is transposed, and a keyboard plugged in later joins by itself. Asked for by Ido.
Two keyboards on the same key each release their own note, and a keyboard unplugged while you hold a key lets go of it, so nothing hangs.
One keyboard only is still a choice in INPUT. IAC buses and a keyboard's DAW-control port are never listened to, so nothing the DAW sends loops back in.
